procedure get_hosp_info is
 -- This procedure get the source and destination hospital
 -- information (ie. hospital name and address)
begin
 --
 -- Get the source hospital information
 --
 begin
 select name, substr(address_1 || ' ' || address_2 || ' ' ||
 address_3,1,50), consignee_id,
 substr(city || ', ' || state || ' ' || zip||' '||country,1,250),
 customer_id
 into :s_hosp_name, :s_source_address, :s_sconsignee_id,
 :s_city_state_zip, :GLOBAL.src_customer_id
 from consignee co
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and exists (select 'x'
 from transfer_products ps
 where source_hospital = co.consignee_id
 and pick_slip_id = :transfer_slip
 and chapter_id = co.chapter_id);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;

 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get source order number and order date
 --
 begin
 select o.order_no, to_char(o.insert_date, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
 into :GLOBAL.src_ord_no, :GLOBAL.source_order_date
 from orders o, pick_slips ps, pick_slip_products psp
 where o.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and o.order_no = ps.order_no
 and ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and product_status = 'DL'

 (select max(insert_date)
 from pick_slips ps2, pick_slip_products psp2
 where ps2.pick_slip_id != :transfer_slip
 and ps2.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp2.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp2.pick_slip_id = ps2.pick_slip_id
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and product_status = 'DL');
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 show_error_dist('1724'); -- original order not delivered
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get destination order number, consignee ID and order date
 --
 begin
 select o.order_no, o.consignee_id,o.order_class,
 to_char(o.insert_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
 into :GLOBAL.dest_order_no, :s_dconsignee_id,
 :GLOBAL.order_class, :GLOBAL.dest_order_date
 from orders o
 where o.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id

 order_no = o.order_no
 and pick_slip_id = :transfer_slip
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get the destination hospital information
 --
 begin
 select name, substr(address_1 || ' ' || address_2 || ' ' ||
 address_3,1,50), customer_id,
 substr(city || ', ' || state || ' ' || zip|| ' ' ||country,1,250)
 into :s_dest_hosp_name,:s_dest_address, :GLOBAL.des_customer_id,
 :s_dest_city_state_zip
 from consignee c
 where consignee_id = :s_dconsignee_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get the fi_compnay_no from chapter table
 --

 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception

 check_package_failure;

 where product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5)

 then

 check_package_failure;

 and product_code = :product_code
